title: Persist idle network worker rows
summary: Persist idle worker rows when workers poll the coordinator and clarify worker-side persisted-state evidence.
reason: Workers polling an empty coordinator did not create coordinator_inflight.json or idle worker rows because the registry only persisted workers after claimed/completed jobs.
behavior_before: A healthy worker polling an empty coordinator could remain invisible on the coordinator worker board, and the worker-side Network page warned about a missing local coordinator registry file.
behavior_after: Each valid /api/claim poll records the worker in the coordinator registry with last_seen and persists coordinator_inflight.json even when no job is claimable; worker-side empty local state reports idle instead of warning and explains that the worker list lives on the coordinator host.
manual_validation: Select-String on server registry.py and coordinator_http_handlers.py confirmed note_worker_seen and _record_worker_seen_for_board
rollback_plan: Revert note_worker_seen, the /api/claim worker-board persistence call, worker-side warning changes, and related WebView copy/tests; coordinator worker board would again only show claimed/completed workers.
notes: The bundled Python environment did not have pytest installed, so targeted tests were run with unittest and PYTHONPATH=src.
